messages.content: Give me 5 tips for better sleep.

1. Keep a consistent sleep schedule (same bedtime and wake time even on weekends). 2. Make your bedroom cool, dark, and quiet. 3. Avoid screens at least 30 minutes before bed — blue light delays melatonin. 4. Cut caffeine after 2 pm. 5. Wind down with something calm: reading, light stretching, or a warm shower.
